<title level="1" right="Focus 5" pfs="Standard">
[Fey Glamour](/Spells.aspx?ID=510)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Sorcerer" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=148" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 404 <sup>4.0</sup>

**Bloodline**
[Fey](/Bloodlines.aspx?ID=7)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Area** 30-foot burst or

**Target** up to 10 creatures
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

You call upon fey glamours to cloak an area or the targets in illusion. This has the effect of either [_illusory scene_](/Spells.aspx?ID=161) on the area or [_veil_](/Spells.aspx?ID=355) on the creatures, as if heightened to a level 1 level lower than _fey glamour_, using _fey glamour_'s range and duration.
name: Fey Glamour
